description: P35 (plan M6-M9 §5.5, §5.7, §5.13): boulders and timber heaped across the cave at the back of the Troll Den - the Matriarch's way out when she is driven off. A stage-5 giant heaves it aside (requires_permission heave); the woodfolk pull it down 20 s after the den's last brood nest burns, or at once when a Stormborn giant strikes Sedge's bargain (DenWall sets world.troll_den.wall_open, which opens it). Open, by any of these, world.troll_den.wall_open holds: one of the Matriarch's drive-out flags.
locked_message: It will not move. Grow to stage 5 - or burn the den's nests and the woodfolk will pull it down.
